pr_title: Project panel: Deselect entries on remaining blank space click + Remove hover color for selected entries
pr_body: Closes #22072 Clicking on the remaining space now allows a single click to deselect all selected items. Check the issue for a preview of the current state and how it works in VSCode. Bonus: I found the hover color on selected items to be distracting. When I have many entries selected and hover over them, it becomes hard to tell if a particular entry is selected while the mouse pointer is on it. This PR removes hover coloring for selected entries, mimicking how VSCode handles it. This PR: Release Notes: - Clicking on empty space in the Project Panel now deselects all selected items.
pr_comments:
This PR broke the beautiful fix in https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/21926 again.

As far as I understand, items that are hovered and marked active should have the hover background and not the marked active background. At the very least the knockout item background and the item background should be the same.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/e860b462-02ce-49de-a7d0-f0c114b40156

cc @bennetbo

This change was inspired by the behavior in VSCode, Firefox sidebar, and Dolphin (KDE File Manager). When an item is selected, it doesn’t display a separate hover state to avoid confusing users about whether the item is selected or merely hovered over. Do we agree to keep it as it is?

So, I suppose issue is with knockout item background, I can pick that up. Let me know.

> This change was inspired by the behavior in VSCode, Firefox sidebar, and Dolphin (KDE File Manager). When an item is selected, it doesn’t display a separate hover state to avoid confusing users about whether the item is selected or merely hovered over. Do we agree to keep it as it is?

In that case just addressing the the knockout color sounds great to me, thanks! :)
Just to clarify, I am not part of the Zed team, so I have zero say in the decision-making. It's just my opinion.

issue_context.title: Deselect project panel entries when clicked on remaining blank space
issue_context.body: ### Check for existing issues - [X] Completed ### Describe the feature Currently, there is no way to deselect entries in the project panel. After selecting multiple entries, I sometimes just want to clear the selection. In VSCode, you can do this by clicking on the blank space. VSCode: Zed: A single click doesn't work. Repeatedly clicking triggers the creation of a new file, and dismissing that deselects items. ### Environment Zed: v0.167.0 (Zed Dev f9d70301279636f1d34fe28cd63b3c86fe1c3ab3) OS: Linux Wayland ubuntu 24.04 Memory: 31.1 GiB Architecture: x86_64 GPU: Intel(R) Graphics (RPL-S) || Intel open-source Mesa driver || Mesa 24.0.9-0ubuntu0.2 ### If applicable, add mockups / screenshots to help present your vision of the feature _No response_
